nodes.label: Dad's bike-chain lesson
nodes.fact: Dad made you fix it three times; you still check things thrice.

nodes.label: Calling Mom, then Dad
nodes.fact: Good news goes to Mom first, then Dad, who still gets happy.

nodes.label: Remembering for Dad
nodes.fact: When Dad forgot your birthday, you chose to remember for both.

nodes.label: Rescheduling cancelled plans
nodes.fact: When friends cancel, you pick a new day right away.

nodes.label: Keep Dad's letters
nodes.fact: You'd tell your younger self to sleep more and keep Dad's letters.

nodes.label: Ella born at 6:12
nodes.fact: Ella arrived at dawn and is a morning person like you.

nodes.label: Ella up at five
nodes.fact: Ella woke you at five, but the morning light made it a seven.

nodes.label: Dad's tomato seeds
nodes.fact: You and Mom planted Dad's seeds; half came up, a good year.

nodes.label: Teaching Ella the chain
nodes.fact: You taught Ella the chain fix, three times, like Dad did.

nodes.label: Ella's advice question
nodes.fact: You ask Ella what she'd tell a friend; she usually knows.

nodes.label: Christmas Eve pride notes
nodes.fact: Everyone reads aloud one proud thing, and nobody may be modest.

nodes.label: Free Saturday river run
nodes.fact: Your ideal Saturday: a river run, pancakes, then nothing planned.

nodes.label: Morning person, not owl
nodes.fact: You're a morning person who sometimes stays up for friends.

nodes.label: Tea for exams, coffee runs
nodes.fact: You drink tea before exams and coffee before runs.

nodes.label: Burlington marathon
nodes.fact: You walked at mile 22 and still proudly finished.

nodes.label: Half marathon, Mom's seventieth
nodes.fact: You looked forward to a half marathon and Mom's seventieth birthday.

nodes.label: Tired, not nervous
nodes.fact: Before the appointment you were tired, not nervous.

nodes.label: Pre-med to neuroscience
nodes.fact: You switched partly for Dad, partly for unanswered questions.

nodes.label: Studying the brain
nodes.fact: You wondered whether you study the brain to understand or outrun it.

nodes.label: Turned down Seattle
nodes.fact: Staying three hours from Mom mattered more than the title.

nodes.label: Plans you start today
nodes.fact: A plan without a part you can start today is a wish.

nodes.label: Waiting a day angry
nodes.fact: You don't avoid conflict; you wait a day when angry.

nodes.label: Prouder to explain Dad
nodes.fact: You choose the option you'd be prouder to explain to Dad.

nodes.label: No decisions after 10pm
nodes.fact: Big decisions made late at night wait until morning.

nodes.label: Pick and explain why
nodes.fact: You don't say 'whatever works'; you pick and give reasons.

nodes.label: Gentle hard truths
nodes.fact: You say hard things gently, conclusion first, then reasons.

nodes.label: Money buys time together
nodes.fact: Money is for buying time with people, not things.

nodes.label: Hating being late
nodes.fact: You don't hate spontaneity; you hate being late.

nodes.label: Respecting not knowing
nodes.fact: You'd rather know, but respect people who choose not to.

nodes.label: Try once, then ask
nodes.fact: You ask for help after trying once on your own.

nodes.label: Changing your mind
nodes.fact: You distrust anyone who has never changed their mind.

nodes.label: Not great, but handling
nodes.fact: Instead of 'I'm fine,' you say 'not great, but I'm handling it.'
